channel.title: Comments on: Worthy of a Noble Life?
channel.description: taoism, taoist thought, buddha, yoga, tai chi, shakuhachi

item.title: By: Carl Abbott
item.dc:creator: Carl Abbott
item.description:
Oh, I'm not going anywhere willingly Mike. Getting older is an increasing adventure. It is one rare thing we get to experience only once!
Even so, "not rush" you say? Time passes so much more quickly as I age. I can only guess that as we age, we touch real time, not fun-filled fantasy future time. Human life span is as a moth's, and when you realize you’re a moth… poof!

item.title: By: Mike
item.dc:creator: Mike
item.description:
Carl,
I don't debate anything above, but permit me a small editorial: let's not rush the next adventure, huh? I'll bet your wife, kids, and grandchildren (either that you have or will have) extract some value from you being around. I know I do.
Mike
